title: Sausage Party: Foodtopia
description: After killing off all of humanity, Food attempts to create their own utopia.

episodes_data.title: Sausage Party: Foodtopia Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: The great Food Fight has ended. Food reigns victorious over humanity. They’re free to create their own Foodtopia. But not everything is as it seems…

episodes_data.title: Sausage Party: Foodtopia Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Frank, Brenda and Barry embark on a mission to save food hostages before they ALL DIE!! Sammy fills his hole with a new art form: Stand up comedy. But not all is as it seems…

episodes_data.title: Sausage Party: Foodtopia Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Food pride is high. They decide to throw a Burning Man Festival. Frank and Brenda have to hide a secret from Barry. Unfortunately, nothing is as it seems…

episodes_data.title: Sausage Party: Foodtopia Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: A new currency forms a class system in Foodtopia. Frank and Brenda set out to fix it. Though, not everything is as it seems…

episodes_data.title: Sausage Party: Foodtopia Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: A Machiavellian orange, Julius, gains popularity in Foodtopia. Frank and Brenda struggle to maintain control. But not all is as it seems…

episodes_data.title: Sausage Party: Foodtopia Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Election day is upon Foodtopia: Julius versus Frank and Brenda. But relationship trouble threatens their chances. And not all is as it seems…

episodes_data.title: Sausage Party: Foodtopia Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Brenda sets out to find the good in the dictator orange, Julius. Frank ties up some loose ends. And nothing is as it seems…

episodes_data.title: Sausage Party: Foodtopia Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Barry and Sammy have to clear Frank's name and save Foodtopia! Julius must be stopped! But not all is as it seems to be...

episodes_data.title: Sausage Party: Foodtopia Season 2 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Frank copes with Brenda's death by forcing happiness and sharing in Food-topia; Sammy and Barry have to pick up the pieces; Jack hopes to finally be accepted by food.

episodes_data.title: Sausage Party: Foodtopia Season 2 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: After their exile, Frank, Jack, Sammy, and Barry look for a new food society, but tensions rise among the friends.

episodes_data.title: Sausage Party: Foodtopia Season 2 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Leaving Jack behind, Frank, Barry and Sammy secretly explore the advanced and suspiciously perfect town of Newfoodland.

episodes_data.title: Sausage Party: Foodtopia Season 2 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Frank, Barry, Sammy, and Jack find their special place in Newfoodland. Everything seems perfect, until Barry and Jack discover the secret that this utopian city hides.

episodes_data.title: Sausage Party: Foodtopia Season 2 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: The gang grapples with the new information about Newfoodland; Frank discovers the location of Newfoodland's next fuel mission.

episodes_data.title: Sausage Party: Foodtopia Season 2 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: When Frank discovers that Foodtopia is the next town that Newfoodland wants to invade, he enlists Barry to return and warn them. Meanwhile, Sammy's film premieres, and Jack relapses into an old `habit'.

episodes_data.title: Sausage Party: Foodtopia Season 2 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Frank and Barry are surprised to find a now thriving Food-topia; Jack, Sammy and all of Newfoodland are fast approaching, ready to invade.

episodes_data.title: Sausage Party: Foodtopia Season 2 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: The final battle begins between Food-topia and Newfoodland; Frank tries to make things right with Jack.
